resources.string: In the battery settings for Traccar SMS Gateway Plus, select No restrictions. If the app info page opens, look for Battery saver or Battery.
In Background autostart, enable Traccar SMS Gateway Plus. If the shortcut opens app info, look for Autostart there or under Settings → Apps → Permissions.
Android battery optimization exemption is active.
Android battery optimization exemption is inactive.
Check that No restrictions and Background autostart are enabled in Xiaomi settings. These settings require manual confirmation.
If your phone has additional background limits, open the app settings and look for Battery or Background activity.
